title: 临时改计划，礼貌约下次
subtitle: Changing plans without sounding rude

audio.title: Changing plans
audio.note: 完整音频约 2分02秒；今天只听 0:00–1:15。已核对页面音频可播放、实际时长及配套 Transcript。先不要展开原文；完整 Transcript 在来源页的 Transcript 标签中。

sections.title: 1. 无字幕听力｜先听关系和问题（4分钟）
sections.body:
打开来源页，只听 0:00–1:15，先不要看 Transcript。第一遍不要暂停：判断两个人原来准备做什么、谁提出改计划。第二遍只记关键词，例如 Friday、tickets、concert、next week。不要试着翻译每一个词；没听清就先用上下文猜。

听完再做两道主旨题。最后才能展开来源页的完整 Transcript 自查。第三方原文只提示一个短句：‘Something's come up.’
questions: Francesco 为什么来找 Sachi？A. 他想确认戏票并更改周五计划 B. 他要邀请她参加生日聚会 C. 他找不到剧院
Sachi 最不高兴的原因是什么？A. 戏票太贵 B. Francesco 不喜欢音乐会 C. Francesco 不止一次临时改计划
sections.answers:
1. A。他问她是否已经买票，并让她不要买这个周五的票。
2. C。她提到他两周前也改过计划。

sections.title: 2. 精听辨音＋连读弱读（5分钟）
sections.body:
把 0:00–1:15 再听两遍，专抓下面三处。每处按“先听一句 → 暂停模仿两次 → 看提示 → 关文本重听”练习。

① Is everything OK?｜everything 中间不要逐音节重读；is_everything 会自然连起来。
② What's up?｜what's 和 up 连读，听起来接近 /wɒtsʌp/，是“怎么了？”而不是逐词理解。
③ Something's come up.｜come up 连读；come 弱一些，up 承担新信息，意思是“临时出了点事”。

跟读时突出 tickets、Friday、concert、next week；I、to、for 等功能词轻读。最后关掉文字，完整重听 0:00–1:15，看看三处声音是否更容易被抓住。
questions: 哪一个短语表示“临时出了点事”？
把 What's up? 用自然连读说两遍，它在对话中是什么意思？
sections.answers:
1. Something's come up.
2. What's up? 意思是“怎么了？/有什么事？”

sections.title: 3. 原创阅读｜改约而不是直接取消（4分钟）
sections.body: Emma and Nina planned to meet at a new café on Friday evening. On Friday afternoon, Emma's manager asked her to finish an urgent report. Emma knew she could not leave work on time, but she did not want Nina to think she had forgotten. She called her immediately and explained the problem. First, she apologised clearly. Then she suggested two alternatives: meeting later that evening or having brunch on Sunday. Nina was disappointed because she had been looking forward to the café, but she appreciated the early message. Sunday worked better for both of them, so they changed the booking to eleven o'clock. Emma also offered to choose a table by the window. The conversation took less than two minutes. Because Emma explained the reason, apologised and offered a new plan, Nina did not feel ignored. Changing a plan was inconvenient, but good communication kept the friendship comfortable.
questions: What three things did Emma do when she changed the plan?
Why did Nina not feel ignored?
sections.translation: 艾玛和妮娜原计划周五晚上去一家新咖啡馆见面。周五下午，艾玛的经理让她完成一份紧急报告。艾玛知道自己不能准时下班，但她不想让妮娜以为她忘记了约定。她立刻打电话解释情况。首先，她明确道歉；接着，她提出两个替代方案：当天晚些时候见面，或者周日吃早午餐。妮娜有些失望，因为她一直很期待那家咖啡馆，但她很感谢艾玛提前通知。周日对两个人都更合适，所以她们把预订改到十一点。艾玛还提出选一个靠窗的位置。整段对话不到两分钟。因为艾玛解释了原因、道了歉并提供了新计划，妮娜没有觉得自己被忽视。改计划虽然不方便，但良好的沟通让这段友谊依然轻松。
sections.answers:
1. She apologised, explained the reason and suggested alternatives.
2. Emma contacted her early, explained the problem and offered a new plan.

sections.title: 4. 高频词块｜礼貌改约（4分钟）
sections.body:
1. Something's come up.｜临时出了点事。｜I'm sorry, but something's come up at work. 抱歉，工作上临时出了点事。
2. I'm afraid I can't make it.｜恐怕我去不了了。｜I'm afraid I can't make it this evening. 恐怕我今晚去不了了。
3. I'm really sorry.｜我真的很抱歉。｜I'm really sorry for changing the plan. 临时改计划，我真的很抱歉。
4. How about next week?｜下周怎么样？｜How about next week instead? 改到下周怎么样？
5. Are you free then?｜你那时有空吗？｜We could meet on Sunday. Are you free then? 我们可以周日见，你那时有空吗？
6. Would Sunday work for you?｜周日你方便吗？｜Would Sunday morning work for you? 周日上午你方便吗？
7. Thanks for letting me know.｜谢谢你告诉我。｜Thanks for letting me know early. 谢谢你提前告诉我。
8. No problem.｜没问题。｜No problem. We can meet another day. 没问题，我们可以改天见。
9. reschedule｜重新安排时间｜Can we reschedule our dinner? 我们可以重新安排晚餐时间吗？
sections.answers: 优先记住 7 个词块：Something's come up. / I'm afraid I can't make it. / I'm really sorry. / How about next week? / Are you free then? / Would Sunday work for you? / Thanks for letting me know.

sections.title: 5. 语法｜How about + 名词或动词-ing？（3分钟）
sections.body:
用 How about ...? 提出替代方案。后面可以接时间或名词，也可以接动词-ing；不能直接接动词原形。

例句 1：How about next Friday? 下周五怎么样？
例句 2：How about meeting on Sunday morning? 周日上午见面怎么样？
questions: 改成自然建议：We can have lunch on Sunday. → How about ...?
sections.answers:
1. meeting
2. How about having lunch on Sunday? / How about lunch on Sunday?

sections.title: 6. 对话＋替换＋快速回应（3分钟）
sections.body:
原创对话
A: Hi, are we still meeting at seven?
B: I'm really sorry, but something's come up at work. I'm afraid I can't make it.
A: Oh, OK. Thanks for letting me know.
B: How about Sunday afternoon instead?
A: Sunday works for me. Shall we meet at three?
B: Perfect. I promise I won't change it again!

替换练习
① at seven → for lunch；at work → at home；Sunday afternoon → Monday evening。
② meet at three → have coffee at four；Sunday works for me → Monday would be better。

快速回应：3 秒内开口。
1) 你今晚去不了：I'm really sorry, but I'm afraid I can't make it.
2) 朋友改约，你接受：No problem. Thanks for letting me know.
3) 你提出周日替代方案：How about Sunday? Would that work for you?

30–60 秒口头任务：给朋友留一段语音，礼貌取消今晚的聚会。包含道歉、简单原因、一个替代时间和一个确认问题。先用四个词块搭骨架，不要逐句翻译中文。
sections.answers: 示例：Hi, I'm really sorry, but something's come up at work and I can't make it tonight. How about Sunday afternoon instead? Would three o'clock work for you? Please let me know.

sections.title: 7. 复习＋反馈（1分钟）
sections.body:
复习昨天 3 个邀请词块，并把它们变成今天的改约场景：
1. Are you free on Friday? → Are you free on Sunday instead?
2. Would you like to come? → Would you like to meet next week?
3. Let me check. → Let me check my calendar.

快速串联：Let me check my calendar. Are you free on Sunday instead?

请回原聊天告诉我：① 第一次无字幕听懂了大约百分之多少；② 最卡的是哪一句；③ 用英文文字或语音完成今天的改约任务。只有实际收到并分析你的语音后，我才会评价发音。
sections.answers: 完成标准：能不看文字说出 3 个改约词块，并在 30–60 秒内完成一次礼貌改约。
